capabilities: Render and read PDFs with light, sepia, and dark themes and pinch or button zoom
Highlight, underline, strike through, box, and comment on text with seven mark types
Search the full PDF with page-highlighted matches and open a searchable table of contents
Store annotations as checksum-verified local bundles and export them to readable Markdown
Copy Markdown links to annotations and index quoted text for vault search
extras: The source PDF is never modified; annotations live under .lumen-pdf/ with append-only journals, checksum-verified backups, and an importer for legacy annotation data. Not yet in the community directory per the install notes. Requires Obsidian 1.13.7 or newer on desktop, iOS, and Android.
intentEvidence: Lumen is an independent rewrite from a standalone product specification.
problem: Obsidian's built-in PDF view only displays documents; it lacks text markup, per-annotation notes, in-PDF search, and durable annotation storage for research reading.

relations.evidence: Zotero and Alex Annotator helped identify useful interaction concepts in the broader PDF-annotation space
Zotero and Alex Annotator helped identify useful interaction concepts in the broader PDF-annotation space
Omnisearch also indexes them when installed.
Include .lumen-pdf/ in GitSync on both devices.

summary: PDF reader and annotator that renders PDFs in Obsidian with highlights, comments, full-document search, themes, and locally stored, recoverable annotations.
